history.fungible.notes: erc20 asset transfers only. A page is not a complete token history and is not an approval scan. Not a live pass.

history.native_external.notes: external category, fromAddress and toAddress queried separately, pageKey until absent, fixed fromBlock and toBlock. 120 CU per call is an estimate. Not a live pass.

history.native_internal.notes: This path does not request internal transfers. A missing internal read is not an empty history.

history.nft.notes: erc721 and erc1155 transfers can be returned. This adapter does not mark NFT history complete. Not a live pass.

permissions.erc1155_operator.notes: Asset transfers do not complete ApprovalForAll. This capability stays unsupported here.

permissions.erc20.notes: Asset transfers do not complete Approval. This capability stays unsupported here.

permissions.erc721_operator.notes: Asset transfers do not complete ApprovalForAll. This capability stays unsupported here.

permissions.erc721_token.notes: Asset transfers do not complete Approval. This capability stays unsupported here.

permits.offchain_unused.notes: 未提交的離線簽名不可觀察，不能標成 complete。

limits.name: alchemy_getAssetTransfers
limits.notes: Published compute-unit table lists alchemy_getAssetTransfers at 120 CU per call. This package records that as an estimate, not a live measurement. maxCount stays 1000 (0x3e8). pageKey continues until it is absent. fromAddress and toAddress are separate calls. fromBlock and toBlock stay a fixed window, never latest.

limits.name: alchemy_free_tier
limits.notes: Free tier is about 30,000,000 compute units per month and 300 compute units per second. Recorded as an estimate from the pricing page, not a live quota read.

notes: JSON-RPC alchemy_getAssetTransfers for Base external, erc20, erc721, and erc1155 transfers. fromAddress and toAddress are separate calls. pageKey is followed until it is absent. fromBlock and toBlock are a fixed window. 120 CU per call is an estimate. Internal transfers are not requested. Approval and ApprovalForAll stay on the log path. Free eth_getLogs is 10 blocks and is not an allowed method here. No live verification.
